take: The bye is close to locked (98.8%), so your season is really two games: Week 16 and Week 17. Every move below is judged mostly on those two lineups, with Weeks 12 to 14 still counted so nobody who stinks until then sneaks in.
You win it all in 38.1% of sims. Next best is Chasing Brown Huzz at 19.7%. That's up from 31.4% last update.
Best trade they should actually accept: D'Andre Swift for CeeDee Lamb + Tetairoa McMillan with King Henrys BBC. Title odds +3.8 and their lineup moves -0.9 a week.
Backup plan: Rome Odunze for George Pickens (Cotton Pickens), +1.8.
Swing big if they bite: D'Andre Swift for CeeDee Lamb + Jaylen Warren (King Henrys BBC) is worth +6.2, but it hurts their lineup so expect a no unless they're desperate.
Biggest risk: C.J. Stroud getting hurt costs you 22.7 points of title odds. Make sure you have a real backup there.
Waivers: Dameon Pierce (RB) for Seth McGowan adds about 14.0 weighted lineup points.
